gloss: how; in what way; depending on

definitions.gloss: how; in what way; the state of things
definitions.explanation: A formal word meaning "how" or "in what manner." Used to refer to the nature or state of something, often in combination with particles to create grammatical patterns.
When combined with specific particles, creates fixed patterns meaning "depending on" (〜いかんで/いかんによって) or "regardless of" (〜いかんにかかわらず/いかんによらず).

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いかん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わない→問う：02299_tou⟧。
{事|こと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いかん⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧。
examples.english: Depending on the circumstances, we will take measures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わら→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧ず⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧だ。
examples.english: Everyone participates regardless of their grades.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今後|こんご}→今後：02808_kongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧いかん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The outcome will change depending on the response going forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いかん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず、⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{認|みと}められない→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧。
examples.english: Tardiness is not permitted regardless of the reason.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧いかん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The results change greatly depending on one's effort.

notes:
A formal, literary word written in hiragana. Can also be written as {如何|いかん} using kanji, though hiragana is more common in modern usage. Functions as a noun but is almost always used in fixed grammatical patterns.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いかん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず: regardless of (very formal)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わら→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧ず: regardless of (formal)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧よらず: regardless of (formal)
- 〜いかん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: depending on
- 〜いかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧よっては: depending on (the case)
- 〜いかん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かかわらず: regardless of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かかわらず: regardless of — more common, less formal version
- 〜⟦{次第|しだい}→次第：03175_shidai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: depending on — everyday equivalent of 〜いかん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わ→問う：02299_tou⟧ず: regardless of — similar pattern but without いかん
- 〜⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧: depending on — the standard neutral equivalent

REGISTER:
Formal to very formal. Common in legal documents, official announcements, business communications, and news. Rarely used in casual conversation.
